title.narrative: Enhancing joint Accountability and Support Systems for Women and Girls in Rushinga District

description.narrative: Through citizen action for transparency and social accountability monitoring, CCJP will enhance citizen’s efforts to hold duty bearer to account, ensure that communities are engaged, informed, and are active participants in the process. The aim of this project is to empower communities with skills and knowledge on advocacy, lobby, and social accountability monitoring so that communities become lead agents of change. The project also seeks establish or strengthen social accountability mechanisms in Rushinga and Mbire Districts to enhance the effective implementation and monitoring of programs addressing violence against women and girls (VAWG), gender-based violence (GBV), and child protection. By fostering community engagement, improving data collection and sharing, and equipping local leaders and community members with advocacy skills, the project seeks to create a responsive and accountable framework that prioritizes the needs of survivors and upholding of women and girl’s rights.
